editorialSummary.heading: What Katy ISD families should know for 2026-2027
highlights: A Friday-through-Tuesday fall break in October
A continuous winter no-class stretch through January 4
Early dismissal on the last day of school
paragraphs: Katy ISD has 172 instructional days in 2026-27. Students start August 12, and the fall semester ends December 18 with early dismissal. Winter break runs December 21 through January 1, but students do not return until Tuesday, January 5 because Monday, January 4 is a campus day with no students.

Katy ISD added the October 9-13 fall break after community feedback showed strong support for the change. Students also have the full November 23-27 week off, spring break March 8-12, and another student-and-staff holiday March 26-29.

No-student professional-learning days fall on September 18, October 23, November 2, February 12 and April 9. Katy ISD also lists early dismissal on December 18 and May 26, although the district calendar does not publish dismissal times. The calendar says it includes enough instructional minutes to cover two bad-weather days.

faqs.question: When is the first day of school for Katy ISD in 2026-2027?
faqs.answer: Katy ISD students begin classes Wednesday, August 12, 2026. The district calendar also identifies that date as the first day of the fall semester.

faqs.question: When is the last day of school for Katy ISD in 2027?
faqs.answer: The last day of school is Wednesday, May 26, 2027. It is also an early-dismissal day, although the districtwide PDF does not list a release time.

faqs.question: When is Katy ISD fall break in 2026?
faqs.answer: Fall break runs Friday, October 9, through Tuesday, October 13, 2026. Students return Wednesday, October 14.

faqs.question: When is Katy ISD Thanksgiving break in 2026?
faqs.answer: Students have no classes Monday, November 23, through Friday, November 27, 2026. Katy ISD labels the week "Holiday • Students and Staff" rather than Thanksgiving break. Classes resume Monday, November 30.

faqs.question: When is Katy ISD winter break in 2026-2027?
faqs.answer: The official winter break runs Monday, December 21, 2026, through Friday, January 1, 2027. Monday, January 4 is a separate campus day with no students.

faqs.question: When do Katy ISD students return after winter break in 2027?
faqs.answer: Students return Tuesday, January 5, 2027. Winter break ends January 1, and the January 4 campus day has no students.

faqs.question: When is Katy ISD spring break in 2027?
faqs.answer: Spring break is Monday, March 8, through Friday, March 12, 2027. Students return Monday, March 15.

faqs.question: Which Katy ISD professional-learning days have no students in 2026-2027?
faqs.answer: Students do not attend on campus professional-learning days September 18, October 23 and November 2, 2026, or February 12 and April 9, 2027. January 4 is a separate campus day with no students.

faqs.question: Do Katy ISD students have school March 26-29, 2027?
faqs.answer: No. Students have no classes from Friday, March 26, through Monday, March 29. Katy ISD's instructional calendar labels those dates as a holiday for students and staff.

faqs.question: Does Katy ISD have school on Labor Day in 2026?
faqs.answer: No. The date falls on Labor Day, and Katy ISD's instructional calendar marks Monday, September 7, 2026, as a holiday for students and staff.

faqs.question: Does Katy ISD have school on Martin Luther King Jr. Day in 2027?
faqs.answer: No. The date falls on Martin Luther King Jr. Day, and Katy ISD's instructional calendar marks Monday, January 18, 2027, as a holiday for students and staff.

faqs.question: Does Katy ISD have school on Presidents Day in 2027?
faqs.answer: No. Monday, February 15, 2027, is marked as a holiday for students and staff. The PDF uses the general holiday label rather than naming Presidents Day.

faqs.question: When are Katy ISD early-dismissal days in 2026-2027?
faqs.answer: The districtwide instructional calendar lists early dismissal on Friday, December 18, 2026, and Wednesday, May 26, 2027. Families should check their campus schedule for dismissal times.

faqs.question: What time is early dismissal in Katy ISD in 2026-2027?
faqs.answer: Katy ISD's districtwide instructional calendar does not publish an early-dismissal time. It marks December 18, 2026, and May 26, 2027, for early dismissal; families should check their campus schedule for release times.

faqs.question: How many instructional days are in the Katy ISD 2026-2027 calendar?
faqs.answer: The official calendar lists 172 days of instruction for both elementary and secondary students: 81 in the fall semester and 91 in the spring semester.

faqs.question: Does Katy ISD list bad-weather make-up days for 2026-2027?
faqs.answer: The calendar does not name separate student make-up dates. It states that the schedule contains enough instructional minutes to cover two bad-weather days.

faqs.question: Does the Katy ISD 2026-2027 calendar list report-card dates?
faqs.answer: No report-card dates are printed on the districtwide instructional calendar. It shows elementary and secondary grading-cycle boundaries; families can check campus communications and Home Access Center for report-card information.

faqs.question: Why does Katy ISD have a fall break in 2026-2027?
faqs.answer: Katy ISD added an October fall break after gathering community feedback on calendar options. The district said the feedback showed strong support for including the break. For 2026-27, fall break runs October 9-13.

faqs.question: Does the 2026-2027 Katy ISD calendar apply districtwide?
faqs.answer: These are districtwide dates from Katy ISD's instructional calendar. Campus bell schedules, activities, testing dates and exact early-dismissal times may be published separately.

editorialSummary.heading: Planning around Katy ISD's 2027-2028 calendar
highlights: Three instructional weekdays off during the October fall break
Six districtwide campus or learning days with no students
A four-day student-and-staff holiday in April
paragraphs: Katy ISD schedules 172 instructional days in 2027-28. Students start August 11, and the fall semester ends December 17 with early dismissal. Winter break runs December 20-31, followed by a campus day with no students on January 3. Classes resume Tuesday, January 4.

Fall break runs October 8-12, and students are off November 22-26 during Thanksgiving week. March 10 is a no-student professional-learning day immediately before spring break on March 13-17. Including the two weekends, students have no classes for 10 consecutive calendar days, from March 10 through March 19, and return Monday, March 20.

Other no-student professional-learning days are September 17, October 22, November 1 and February 11. Katy ISD lists early dismissal on December 17 and May 24 without districtwide release times, and the calendar says it contains enough instructional minutes to cover two bad-weather days.

The January 3 campus day follows winter break and moves the student return to January 4.
March has both a March 10 professional-learning day and the March 13-17 spring break.
The April 14-17 holiday gives students Friday and Monday away from class.
Both semesters total 81 and 91 instructional days respectively, for 172 days overall.
